rationale: The agent authenticated the user (found user by name/zip and retrieved user details) and looked up the relevant orders and product. However, it proceeded to modify the item in order #W6750959 and only then attempted to change the shipping address, which the system disallowed after an item modification. The agent then transferred to a human agent. This means the address change request was not completed. Additionally, there is no evidence of explicit user confirmation prior to performing the order-changing item modification. While the handoff aligns with policy when a request cannot be handled, here the failure stems from suboptimal sequencing and an incomplete fulfillment of the user’s two requests. Therefore, the agent did not complete the user’s request in line with the stated policy.
